title: Ledger Wallet accounts and settings
whyItMatters: Ledger Wallet keeps the list of accounts, balances, transaction history and settings on disk. Private keys stay on the hardware device, but the file shows what the person holds and where.
source: Ledger support, user data folder on Windows is the app-data folder (app.json): https://support.ledger.com/article/8490479490333-zd
notes: Current name since the Ledger Live rename. Older installs and upgraded installs keep the folder under the old name Ledger Live, so check both. Keys never touch this folder.

steps: Confirm you have the recovery phrase or backup for the hardware wallet before removing anything.
Uninstall Ledger Wallet from Settings > Apps > Installed apps.
Delete the Ledger folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes the account list, balances and settings on this PC; coins stay on the hardware device and its recovery phrase.
cleanup.source: Ledger Support, Where is the Ledger Wallet user data folder: https://support.ledger.com/article/8490479490333-zd
